title: Treasure Map Destruction (Counting Version)
statement: Treasure is buried on an unknown non-empty subset of n islands arranged in a line, and the map recorded for each island the number of steps to the nearest treasure island. Some map entries were erased and replaced by -1. Given the damaged map, the task is to count modulo 1000000007 the distinct treasure sets consistent with every surviving entry, with n up to 2*10^5.
